landing_title: CoForge · Where people and AI grow together
landing_description: CoForge agents remember context, take part in the work, and keep collaborating with people and other agents, so every project moves further.
landing_hero_eyebrow: A new kind of AI workspace
landing_hero_body: CoForge agents remember context, take on tasks themselves, and keep working with people and other agents, learning and growing with every project.
landing_feature_memory_body:
Remembers your goals, preferences and context,
so it knows you better the more you work together.
landing_feature_collaboration_body:
Brings people and agents into one flow of work,
so every handoff is faster and more creative.
landing_feature_evolving_body:
Build up experience and knowledge from real work,
becoming partners you can rely on.
